reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: util_rate has active non-test callers in market.move:1024 and market_query.move:68,77. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in scope; entry point is unprivileged normal user triggering accrue_interest. Gate 3: reserve.move is explicitly in-scope and interest rate manipulation is a focus area. An attacker can trigger this via any protocol operation (borrow/repay/deposit/withdraw) on a near-fully-utilized pool by allowing natural interest accrual to cause cash_reserve > cash (e.g., cash=1, reserve_factor=0.1, interest=20 => cash_reserve=2), causing util_rate > 1.0 which makes calc_interest return a borrow rate exceeding max_borrow_rate and causing withdraw_underlying (L313) to revert, locking depositor funds indefinitely. Severity capped at High: condition requires near-100% utilization but is realistic and self-reinforcing once triggered; impact is depositor fund DoS and unbounded borrow rate compounding.
